description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection by text and structured filters, ranked by relevance or sorted by date. Text matches all words across titles, artists, descriptions, provenance, and other catalog fields. Filters combine with AND. Results reach the first 1,000 matches; narrow with filters for more. Set limit to 0 with facets to get only counts. Use artic_lookup_vocabulary for filter values and artic_get_artworks for full records.

artist.description: Artist or culture name matched against every credited artist (all words must match).

artist_id.description: Agent id from artic_search_artists or an artist facet row; matches preferred and other credits.

artwork_type.description: Artwork type title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Painting or Print.

classification.description: Classification title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as oil on canvas or etching.

department.description: Department title exactly as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Prints and Drawings.

facets.description: Facet counts to compute over the filtered set (top 15 values each): department, artwork_type, style, subject, classification, place_of_origin, artist. An array or a comma-separated string.

gallery.description: Gallery where the work is on view, such as Gallery 240 (a bare 240 is read as Gallery 240). Only on-view works carry a gallery.

limit.description: Rows per page (0-12; capped so a page of long catalog records with every facet stays within common tool-output limits); 0 returns only totalCount and facets.

material.description: Material title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as ink or gold leaf.

on_view_only.description: Only works on view at the museum now.

page.description: Page to return (1-based); page times limit may not exceed 1,000.

place_of_origin.description: Place of origin as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as france.

public_domain_only.description: Only public-domain works, whose images are CC0.

query.description: Text matched against titles, artists, descriptions, provenance, and other catalog fields; every word must match. Supports "exact phrase", -exclude, and a | b.

sort.description: relevance ranks by query text, or by museum popularity without it; date_asc and date_desc sort by start year.

style.description: Style title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Impressionism; matches preferred or alternate styles.

subject.description: Subject title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored).

technique.description: Technique title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as black-and-white photography or plain weaving.

theme.description: Theme title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Women artists.

year_from.description: Earliest year; a work matches when its date span overlaps year_from to year_to. Negative for BCE.

year_to.description: Latest year; a work matches when its date span overlaps year_from to year_to. Negative for BCE.

name: artic_search_artworks

artworks.description: Matching artworks on this page, in ranked or sorted order.

artist_display.description: Artist, nationality, and life dates as the museum displays them.

artist_id.description: Id of the preferred credited artist; pass as artist_id to artic_search_artworks.

artwork_type.description: Artwork type, such as Painting or Print.

date_display.description: Date as the museum displays it; the authority when the years are absent.

date_end.description: Latest year of the date span, negative for BCE; omitted when absent or implausible.

date_start.description: Earliest year of the date span, negative for BCE; omitted when absent or implausible.

gallery.description: Gallery where the work is on view, such as Gallery 240.

image.description: Primary image with constructed IIIF URLs and its reuse status; absent when the work has no image.

alt_text.description: Alt text the museum wrote for the image.

iiif_info_url.description: IIIF info.json URL listing the image dimensions, sizes, and tiles.

rights.description: Reuse status: public_domain images are CC0; in_copyright images need a rights check before reuse.

url.description: IIIF image 843 px wide, the museum display size; available for every image, public domain or not.

url_large.description: IIIF image 1686 px wide; present only for public-domain works.

is_on_view.description: True when the work is on view at the museum now.

is_public_domain.description: True when the work is public domain, so its images are CC0.

title.description: Title as catalogued; empty when the museum lists none.

web_url.description: Public page for the artwork on artic.edu.

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `page_beyond_window`: page times limit exceeds 1,000, past the reachable search window. `invalid_year_range`: year_from is later than year_to. `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Counts over the filtered set for each requested facet; present only when facets were requested.

artist.description: Top artists over the filtered set, most common first.

artist_id.description: Agent id; pass it back as the artist_id filter.

name.description: Artist name as written; absent when the museum record carries none.

artwork_type.description: Top artwork_type values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the artwork_type filter.

classification.description: Top classification values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the classification filter.

department.description: Top department values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the department filter.

place_of_origin.description: Top place_of_origin values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the place_of_origin filter.

style.description: Top style values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the style filter.

subject.description: Top subject values over the filtered set, most common first.

items.description: One facet value and its count.

value.description: Value as indexed; pass it back verbatim as the subject filter.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

license_text.description: License statement from the API for this data, verbatim.

next_page.description: Page to request next; absent when nothing remains or the next page would pass the first 1,000 matches.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, more pages exist, or the reachable window is exhausted.

sort_applied.description: Order applied; popularity when relevance was requested without query text (the museum popularity ranking).

totalCount.description: Matches for the query and filters, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.
